script: NASA's Opportunity rover was built to last 90 days on Mars. It kept working for almost 15 years. It drove about 45 kilometers, longer than a marathon. Winds sometimes blew dust off its solar panels and gave it new life. It sent its last message in 2018, during a giant dust storm. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
